raw:
{
  "items": [
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Full in-plane design domain",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 refers the geometry to Fig. 5. The text gives neither the boundary dimensions nor the aspect ratio. A 200 x 200 element count does not establish physical dimensions or normalize the quoted local lengths. Let W and H denote the horizontal and vertical spans.",
      "readings": [
        "A unit square, W = H = 1, with 0.04 and 0.025 interpreted in those coordinate units.",
        "A square, W = H = 2, with 0.04 and 0.025 interpreted in those coordinate units.",
        "A rectangle, W = 2 and H = 1, with 0.04 and 0.025 interpreted in those coordinate units."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "domain_extent",
      "entity": "Out-of-plane thickness",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The two-dimensional formulation and Sec. 3.1 do not specify the constant thickness used to assemble stiffness and interpret distributed loads.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform thickness t = 1.",
        "Uniform thickness t = 0.1."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "support_location_extent",
      "entity": "Boundary nodes constrained against vertical displacement",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 says 'center nodes on each side' without explicitly identifying the sides. This can refer to the two opposing compression sides or all four sides.",
      "readings": [
        "Constrain u_y at (0,H/2) and (W,H/2).",
        "Constrain u_y at all four boundary midpoints: (0,H/2), (W,H/2), (W/2,0), and (W/2,H)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_position",
      "entity": "Longitudinal positions of the two compression loads",
      "issue": "figure_only",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 places the loads around the horizontal symmetry axis but does not name their application boundaries or give their horizontal coordinates. The domain arrangement is referred to Fig. 5.",
      "readings": [
        "Apply the loads on the exterior left and right boundaries, x = 0 and x = W, centered at y = H/2.",
        "Apply the loads on interior vertical segments at x = 0.025 and x = W - 0.025, corresponding to inward faces of end pads of depth 0.025."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_extent_distribution",
      "entity": "Spatial profiles and nodal assembly of the distributed loads",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies a load width of 0.04 but gives neither the distribution over that width nor the construction of the finite-element force vector.",
      "readings": [
        "Uniform line traction assembled with consistent Q4 edge forces, giving half weights at the endpoints of an aligned patch.",
        "Equal point forces at every mesh node covered by the load band, normalized to the prescribed resultant.",
        "A symmetric triangular line traction, zero at the band endpoints and maximum at its center, normalized to the prescribed resultant."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "load_magnitude",
      "entity": "Meaning of 10^-3 at each distributed load",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 gives the magnitude at each load without specifying whether it is a force resultant, line intensity, or traction stress.",
      "readings": [
        "Total force resultant 10^-3 on each load patch.",
        "Line-force intensity 10^-3 per unit length, giving resultant 4 x 10^-5 over a patch of length 0.04.",
        "Traction stress 10^-3, giving resultant 4 x 10^-5 times thickness over a patch of length 0.04."
      ],
      "effect": "scale_only"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Solid regions at the loads",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 supplies only a width of 0.025 and the phrase 'located at the loads'. It does not determine the two-dimensional shapes, the orientation of that width, or the other dimension.",
      "readings": [
        "Rectangular end pads with horizontal depth 0.025 and vertical height 0.04, centered on the load bands.",
        "Rectangular end pads with horizontal depth 0.04 and vertical height 0.025.",
        "Square end pads of size 0.025 x 0.025.",
        "Full-height boundary strips with horizontal depth 0.025."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "passive_region",
      "entity": "Enforcement of passive solids through filtering and projection",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 does not explain how passive solids are imposed in the filtered two-field construction of Eqs. (5)-(7) and (19). Fixing raw variables and fixing physical densities produce different transition regions.",
      "readings": [
        "Override physical density to 1 in the passive mask after filtering and projection for all three realizations.",
        "Fix raw x = s = 1 in the passive mask before filtering, allowing the filters and projections to produce transition densities there."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "material",
      "entity": "Void-stiffness regularization in the singlescale SIMP law",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "The introduction identifies cubic SIMP in the Fig. 1 comparison, but Sec. 3.1 delegates the singlescale implementation to [18]. The supplied text does not write how its SIMP law incorporates the void-stiffness floor.",
      "readings": [
        "Modified cubic SIMP: E(rho) = 10^-6 + (1 - 10^-6) rho^3.",
        "Cubic SIMP with a clipped stiffness floor: E(rho) = max(10^-6, rho^3)."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Lower bound x_min on the density field",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Eq. (19) retains x_min symbolically, and Sec. 3.1 assigns no value. The value 0.27 is introduced specifically for the L-beam in Sec. 3.2.",
      "readings": [
        "x_min = 0.001.",
        "x_min = 0.1.",
        "x_min = 0.27, reusing the later L-beam choice."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "volume_fraction",
      "entity": "Adaptive dilated-volume limit V_d*",
      "issue": "vague",
      "description": "Sec. 2 says V_d* is continuously updated to enforce the blueprint target, and Sec. 3.1 sets that target to 0.15. Its initialization and update formula are not supplied.",
      "readings": [
        "Initialize V_d* = 0.15; each iteration replace it by 0.15 times the current dilated-volume fraction divided by the current blueprint-volume fraction.",
        "Initialize V_d* using the initial dilated-to-blueprint volume ratio; each iteration relax halfway toward 0.15 times the current ratio."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Initial fields for the first pure-compliance optimization",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies reuse of designs for subsequent weights but does not specify the initial x and s fields for the first omega = 1 run. Uniform initialization is stated only for Sec. 3.2.",
      "readings": [
        "On free cells, initialize x = 1 and choose uniform s to satisfy the initial blueprint volume budget.",
        "On free cells, initialize x = 0.5 and choose uniform s to satisfy the initial blueprint volume budget.",
        "Use a nonuniform initial design symmetric about both center axes and satisfying the same volume budget."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "MMA update controls",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 2.2.3 and Appendix B identify MMA but do not provide move limits or initial and adaptive asymptote settings.",
      "readings": [
        "Move limit 0.05 of each variable range, initial asymptote half-width 0.5 of that range, expansion factor 1.2, and contraction factor 0.7.",
        "Move limit 0.2 of each variable range, initial asymptote half-width 0.1 of that range, expansion factor 1.1, and contraction factor 0.5."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "filter_or_solver_setting",
      "entity": "Optimization termination",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3 specifies the beta continuation but gives no final convergence test, iteration cap, or required optimization duration after beta reaches 256.",
      "readings": [
        "After beta reaches 256, stop when maximum design-variable change stays below 10^-3 for 10 iterations.",
        "After beta reaches 256, stop when relative objective change stays below 10^-5 for 20 iterations.",
        "Run a fixed total of 1000 optimization iterations."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    },
    {
      "category": "mesh",
      "entity": "Integration of the bilinear quadrilateral stiffness matrices",
      "issue": "missing",
      "description": "Sec. 3.1 specifies bilinear quadrilaterals, but Sec. 2.1 leaves the elemental matrices to [18]. The supplied text does not specify their quadrature.",
      "readings": [
        "Full 2 x 2 Gauss integration for all stiffness components.",
        "Selective reduced integration: 2 x 2 Gauss integration for the shear component and one-point integration for the bulk component."
      ],
      "effect": "layout"
    }
  ]
}
